push.label: Turn notifications
push.needs_install: On iPhone or iPad, open the Share menu and choose "Add to Home Screen", then open $t(brand.name) from that icon to enable notifications.
push.insecure_context: Push notifications require a secure HTTPS connection.
push.service_worker_unavailable: This browser or browsing mode does not provide Service Workers.
push.push_api_unavailable: This browser or device does not provide the Web Push API.
push.notifications_api_unavailable: This browser or browsing mode does not provide the Notifications API.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Re-allow them in your browser or system settings first.
push.server_unconfigured: Push notifications are not configured on the server.
push.permission_dismissed: Notification permission was not granted. Allow notifications in the browser prompt, then try again.
push.permission_request_failed: This browser could not request notification permission. Check this site's notification permission in browser settings.
push.service_worker_not_ready: The background notification service did not become ready. Reload the page, then try again.
push.subscription_not_allowed: The browser or operating system refused to create a push subscription. Check notification and background-app permissions.
push.subscription_service_unavailable: The browser could not reach its push service. Check the network, update the browser, then try again.
push.subscription_failed: The browser failed to create a push subscription. Update the browser or try Chrome.
push.invalid_push_endpoint: This browser returned an invalid push-service address, which is a browser compatibility problem. Update the browser or use Chrome for now.
push.server_registration_rejected: The server rejected the subscription generated by this browser. Update the browser and try again.
push.server_registration_unavailable: The server could not save the push subscription. Try again later.
push.server_enable_rejected: The server rejected the notification setting. Try again or contact an administrator.
push.server_enable_unavailable: The server could not save the notification setting. Check the network and try again.
push.session_changed: The account changed while notifications were being enabled. Select the setting again for this account.
push.server_config_invalid: The server push configuration is incomplete. Contact an administrator.
push.online_only: Notifications work while this page stays online; push after closing the page is currently unavailable.
push.online_hint: Online pages receive notifications directly; alerts after closing the page depend on your browser's push service.
push.unexpected_enable_error: An unexpected error occurred while enabling notifications. Retry once, then report the diagnostic code below.
